methodology.cycles: Strain, average and maximum heart rate, steps, and energy describe the physiological cycle beginning with that main sleep, which may cross midnight. If multiple cycles map to one day, a cycle linked to main sleep takes priority, then the latest cycle is used; strain is never added. An open cycle is provisional. Energy converts WHOOP kilojoules to kcal using 4.184 kJ per kcal.
methodology.dates: Dates use each record's WHOOP timezone offset. Main sleep, its recovery, and its physiological cycle share the main sleep's local wake date. Cycles without an associated main sleep fall back to their local start date. Workouts use their local start date.
methodology.missing: Null means no measurement or not yet scored, never zero. Missing calendar days remain visible as gaps. Biological age and continuous heart-rate samples are not supplied by this API.
methodology.nap_hours: Sum of scored nap sleep ending that day; unknown if any nap has incomplete stages. Zero means no recorded nap.
methodology.recovery: WHOOP recovery, resting heart rate, HRV (RMSSD), SpO2, and skin temperature are joined by cycle ID, never by record creation date.
methodology.sleep_hours: Hours actually asleep in the latest main sleep ending that day: light + deep + REM. Excludes naps, awake time, and intervals without data. All three stages must be present.
methodology.sleep_stages: Deep, REM, light, no-data time, and sleep scores describe that same main sleep. Sleep debt is WHOOP's sleep-needed contribution from prior sleep debt.
methodology.workouts: Count and summed elapsed minutes of recorded workouts starting that day. Zero means no recorded workout; not proof of no exercise. Minutes are unknown if any recorded workout is incomplete.

unavailable.biological_age: Not supplied by the official WHOOP API.
unavailable.continuous_hr: The official WHOOP API provides cycle averages and maxima, not continuous heart-rate samples.
